summary: Frontend-only visual regression test of the 'Midnight Tropical' re-theme (navy/charcoal base + sunset-orange primary + teal accent). Verified Landing (/), Login (/login), Customer Dashboard (/dashboard), Admin Panel (/admin) tabs Overview/Users/Orders/Approvals, Restaurants listing (/restaurants), shadcn Popover (panel chooser dropdown), and the Signup form. Result: NO readability regressions, NO JS/console errors caused by the theme change, NO crashed pages. body bg computed = rgb(10, 24, 36) navy, foreground = white. Login as owner admin (tracyfortune@islandhoptt.com) successfully redirects to /dashboard. Admin Panel renders all tab content cleanly on navy cards with orange active-tab pills, green/teal/red status badges remain legible. shadcn popover ('Choose a panel') opens with a navy popover background and white text — confirms --popover / --popover-foreground tokens are wired through to Radix components. The 6 pre-existing console errors observed (403s before auth + 500 'Error fetching applications: AxiosError') exist in iteration_14 as well and are NOT caused by the theme change.

minor.issue: Returns 500 to authenticated owner admin. Pre-existing, unrelated to theme change. Same error observed in prior iterations.

action_items: No theme-related action items. Midnight Tropical theme passes visual readability QA.
(Carry-over, unrelated to this iteration) Investigate the recurring 500 on the admin 'business-applications' fetch — surfaces as 'Error fetching applications: AxiosError' on /dashboard and /admin.

(Carry-over from iteration_14) OrderTrackingPageWithMaps.js Marker icon `new window.google.maps.Size(40,40)` still needs the deferred-rendering fix — not re-tested in this run as it's outside this theme-only review request.
critical_code_review_comments: tailwind.config.js: the legacy palette names 'matte', 'gold', and 'neon.cyan' were repurposed to navy/orange/teal HEX values — this is fine for the rename-less re-skin, but any future developer searching for 'gold-' classes (e.g. .text-gold, bg-gold-gradient, shadow-gold-glow) will be confused that the color is actually orange. Consider renaming to 'sunset-' / 'navy-' / 'teal-' in a follow-up refactor or at least leaving a comment in tailwind.config.js explaining the intentional name reuse.

index.css :root and .dark blocks are now identical (both define the dark theme). The :root block could either be the light-mode tokens or just delete the .dark block. Today the app is dark-first which is fine, but duplication invites drift.
Scrollbar hover color uses #F97316 (sunset orange) on hover — matches theme; good consistency.
::selection bg uses orange at 35% alpha — legible on navy, good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on theme readability across Landing, Login, Dashboard, Admin (Overview/Users/Orders/Approvals), Restaurants, Popover; signup form renders correctly (functional completion blocked only by browser-native 'phone required' validator which is unchanged behavior)
